remarks: Welcome to 80 Lexington Avenue, Norwalk, CT 06854-a charming two-unit multi-family home perfect for investors or owner-occupants seeking additional income. This property features a total of 7 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, with each unit comprising 3 bedrooms, kitchen, living room and one bathroom. The property includes a fully finished basement where you will find a kitchen, bedroom, and a full bathroom. Additionally, there is ample parking available, with space for up to 5 cars. Situated on a 0.23-acre lot, residents can enjoy a private backyard, ideal for outdoor activities or relaxation. Located in the vibrant South Norwalk neighborhood, this home is within close proximity to local shops, restaurants, parks, and public transportation, making it a convenient and desirable location for tenants or homeowners alike
